movie episodes + anilist primary (README fixture table)
named-season matching without synonyms — 16 anilist entries carry an empty synonyms list; also the largest media in the corpus (62 entries, 38 seasons)

Attack on Titan — 21 anilist entries over 5 seasons; **13 season-0 specials** with scattered src windows (7, 12-13, 14, 15, 17, 18, 20-23, 24-30, 36-37) and 17 src/dst offsets; season 1's title is exactly "Shingeki no Kyojin" (15 synonyms)

Hunter x Hunter — **continuous absolute numbering across seasons** (S1 dst 1-58, S2 dst 59-136, S3 dst 137-148, i.e. src ≠ dst); the only series found whose season-0 episodes still carry an `absolute`
Naruto — 13 entries over 6 seasons with **11 cour-split offsets** and 9 distinct anilist ids (a season split across two anilist entries)
Spirited Away — a real **movie** media: one anilist entry with `season: null`

Bakemonogatari — 21 anilist entries over 7 seasons; its season 2 is **Nisemonogatari**, a second series in the same integral release as Bakemonogatari, so the two carry the same episode numbers and only the season title tells them apart
